description: The Global Configuration keys the Spawner reads (architecture §2.3, implementation §1.2.5).

task_similarity_floor.description: The similarity floor a node is provisioned with when its entry has no eligible row in the floor history (architecture §2.3, §3.13.3).

default_memory_required.description: The memory reservation of a Logic Container whose entry declares no memory_required, in MB (architecture §3.13.10).

catalog_presence_ttl.description: How long the presence mark with which a network declares that it runs an entry lasts without renewal, in milliseconds; the Spawner renews it at a fifth of it (architecture §3.13.3, implementation §6, The initial Global Configuration).

embedding_regeneration_backoff.description: The retries of a failed embedding generation: the first interval, in milliseconds, which doubles on each retry, and how many attempts are made before the generation counts as failed (architecture §3.13.7).

vacancy_rounds_threshold.description: How many successive rounds a task goes without a valid proposal before the Spawner intervenes (architecture §2.3, §3.13.2).

topic_similarity_floor.description: The similarity between topic embeddings at or above which the Spawner treats a vacant topic as redundant with a covered one (architecture §2.3, §3.13.2).

max_successive_candidates.description: How many interventions on a niche that leave it vacant, or replacement candidates, the Spawner makes before it marks the niche capped (architecture §2.3, §3.13.2, §3.13.5).

eviction_pressure_threshold.description: How many evictions within eviction_pressure_window stamp the capacity-pressure key (architecture §2.3, §3.13.10).

eviction_pressure_window.description: The window over which evictions are counted against eviction_pressure_threshold, in milliseconds (architecture §2.3, §3.13.10).

artifact_storage_pressure_share.description: The fraction of the artifact storage capacity above which the Spawner stamps the storage-pressure key (architecture §2.3, §3.13.3).
